instruction: Please help me modify VS Code setting to hide all "node_modules" folders in the explorer view.

metadata.explanation: Task requires hiding node_modules folders in VS Code explorer view. Very similar pattern to original task but targets a different commonly excluded directory. Uses existing check_json_settings metric to verify the files.exclude setting.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement to hide node_modules folders in VS Code explorer
Getter extracts the correct file: /home/user/.config/Code/User/settings.json (standard VS Code user settings location)
Metric check_json_settings correctly validates that the settings file contains the expected key-value pair
Expected value is semantically correct: files.exclude with **/node_modules: true is the proper VS Code setting for hiding node_modules folders
Python's dict comparison handles nested structures correctly, so the check will work for nested dict {"files.exclude": {"**/node_modules": true}}
Complete coverage: evaluator checks exactly what the instruction requires with no missing requirements
No postconfig needed: settings file persists after modifications
Edge cases handled: returns 0.0 if file doesn't exist or has JSON parse errors

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_json_settings first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
metric check_json_settings second parameter type (str) may not match expected.rules type (Dict)
